items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study cannot establish a causal relationship between ankle sprain and functional impairment.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Current Manual Therapy Practices in Pediatric Neurological Physiotherapy: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 61 Greek physiotherapists revealed that 55.7% used manual therapy as an adjunct intervention for children with neurological disorders, rating it most effective for joint mobility and range of motion. Formal manual therapy training correlated with higher perceived effectiveness for pain reduction (p=.013) and sensory processing (p=.004).
items.curatedReason: 这份希腊的调查报告展示了手动治疗在儿童神经物理治疗中的应用现状，特别指出其在改善关节活动度和本体感觉方面的价值。这为你在儿科神经康复中考虑引入或优化手动治疗提供了实证依据，但也要留意其辅助性定位。
items.titleZh: 希腊儿科神经物理治疗中手动治疗的当前实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对61名希腊物理治疗师的横断面调查显示，55.7%的受访者将手动治疗作为儿童神经障碍的辅助干预手段，认为其对关节活动度改善效果最佳。正规手动治疗培训与疼痛减轻（p=.013）和感觉处理（p=.004）的感知有效性呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Greek survey reveals current manual therapy practices in pediatric neurological physiotherapy, highlighting its value in improving joint mobility and proprioception. It provides evidence for considering or optimizing manual therapy in your pediatric neurorehabilitation practice, while also noting its adjunctive role.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，依赖于自我报告，可能存在回忆偏差和选择偏倚，且结果仅代表希腊的执业情况，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey relies on self-reported data, potentially introducing recall and selection bias, and its findings are limited to Greek practice, thus having limited generalizability.

items.title: Effectiveness of In-Clinic Rehabilitation vs. Home-Based Telerehabilitation for Adults with MS in the Deep South: The TEAMS Cluster Randomized Trial.
items.summary: The TEAMS cluster-randomized trial of 759 adults with MS found no significant difference in effectiveness between a 12-week complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) program delivered in-clinic by a therapist (DirectCAM, n=382) versus self-initiated at home via telerehabilitation (TeleCAM, n=377).
items.curatedReason: TEAMS 试验显示，对于多发性硬化症患者，居家远程康复与诊所康复在效果上并无显著差异。这意味着你可以放心地为部分患者提供居家远程方案，扩展服务覆盖。
items.titleZh: 美国南部多发性硬化症成人患者诊所康复与居家远程康复有效性比较：TEAMS 集群随机试验
items.summaryZh: TEAMS 集群随机对照试验发现，对于759名多发性硬化症成人患者，由治疗师在诊所提供的12周辅助与替代医学（CAM）项目（DirectCAM, n=382）与居家自行启动的远程康复（TeleCAM, n=377）在有效性方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TEAMS trial indicates no significant difference in effectiveness between home-based telerehabilitation and in-clinic rehabilitation for MS patients. This allows you to confidently offer home-based telehealth options for some patients, expanding service reach.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于美国南部地区的MS患者，且只评估了12周的CAM项目。
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Experiences of telehealth e-mentoring within postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the United Kingdom.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the experiences of postgraduate physiotherapy mentees and mentors in telehealth e-mentoring in Canada, comparing findings with the UK to understand cross-cultural applicability in musculoskeletal physical therapy education.
items.curatedReason: 远程电子导师制在研究生骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中展现出潜力，尤其在跨文化应用方面。你可以借鉴其在加拿大和英国的经验，优化自身教育或培训项目中的导师机制。
items.titleZh: 远程电子导师制在加拿大和英国研究生骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了加拿大研究生物理治疗学员和导师在远程电子导师制中的经验，并与英国的情况进行了比较，以了解其在骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中跨文化应用的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telehealth e-mentoring shows potential in postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education, particularly for cross-cultural application. You can leverage the experiences from Canada and the UK to optimize mentoring mechanisms in your own educational or training programs.
items.limitation: 研究为定性设计，未提供量化效果数据，且探索的是主观体验。
items.limitationEn: The study employed a qualitative design, providing no quantitative effectiveness data, and focused on subjective experiences.

items.title: Sacroiliac Joint Dysfunction and Associated Disability in the Immediate Postpartum Period: A Cross-Sectional Analysis for Clinical Screening and Rehabilitation
items.summary: This descriptive cross-sectional study, involving 300 postpartum women aged 20-40 years in Sialkot, aimed to determine the prevalence of sacroiliac joint (SIJ) pain and assess the level of associated disability. SIJ pain is a common musculoskeletal condition in postpartum women.
items.curatedReason: 产后女性骶髂关节疼痛很常见，这项在巴基斯坦小样本（300人）的观察研究提示患病率可能不低，但研究设计本身无法提供干预的有效性证据。对你的临床实践来说，了解在特定人群中这一问题的普遍性，对你筛查和管理产后SIJ疼痛有一定提示意义。
items.titleZh: 产后即时期的骶髂关节功能障碍及相关残疾：一项用于临床筛查和康复的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 这项描述性横断面研究在锡亚尔科特对 300 名 20-40 岁的产后女性进行了调查，旨在确定骶髂关节（SIJ）疼痛的患病率并评估其相关功能障碍程度。骶髂关节疼痛是产后女性常见的肌肉骨骼疾病。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sacroiliac joint pain is common in postpartum women. This small-sample (300 individuals) observational study from Pakistan suggests a potentially high prevalence, but its design cannot offer evidence for intervention effectiveness. For your clinical practice, understanding the prevalence in this specific population provides some direction for screening and managing postpartum SIJ pain.
items.limitation: 作为描述性横断面研究，本研究无法揭示病因或干预效果，且结果可能存在地域限制。
items.limitationEn: As a descriptive cross-sectional study, it cannot reveal causality or intervention effects, and its findings may have geographical limitations.

items.title: Relationship Between Physiological Mirror Activity and Corticomuscular Coherence During a Finger Dexterity Task Among Healthy Young and Older Adults
items.summary: This cross-sectional study investigated the relationship between physiological mirror activity (pMA) and corticomuscular coherence (CMC) during a left-hand finger dexterity task in 31 young and 24 older adults. It found that pMA, quantified by changes in right-hand EMG, was inversely associated with gamma-band CMC in both groups, with age-related differences in pMA.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究揭示了生理性镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性在年轻人和老年人手指精细运动中的关系。这为你理解神经生理学机制及其在不同年龄组中的差异提供了基础，有助于你在神经康复中更精细地评估和干预。
items.titleZh: 健康年轻和老年人手指精细活动中生理性镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性的关系
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究调查了 31 名年轻成人和 24 名老年成人进行左手手指精细活动时，生理性镜像活动（pMA）与皮层肌肉相干性（CMC）之间的关系。研究发现，由右手肌电图变化量化的 pMA 与伽马波段 CMC 呈负相关，且 pMA 存在年龄相关差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reveals the relationship between physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence during fine finger dexterity in young and older adults. This provides a foundational understanding of neurophysiological mechanisms and their age-related differences, aiding in more refined assessment and intervention in neurological rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, precluding the establishment of causality, and it has a relatively small sample size.
